title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Berry Breeze Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Berry Breeze Nic Salt is a juicy fruit medley that balances sweet and tart flavours for a lively, satisfying vape. It brings together a variety of Mixed Berries, delivering notes that are bright, tangy and sweet in equal measure. This one is a great choice for fans of full-bodied fruit blends. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits and vape pens. Its available in 10mg and 20mg strengths for a comfortable throat hit and quick nicotine satisfaction. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
